title: Record the circular-section Neumann bound
body:
## Summary
- The narrow Neumann note proves the three norm bounds for a linear band. Its compression sentence does not cover the periodic axes and finite sections used by the #4100 Gaussian caller.
- Every principal section of a circular band obeys the same bounds, by counting walks inside a circular arc. A length-8 section on `{0,1,7}` has induced linear bandwidth 2, so compression does not apply there, and the norm bound still holds.
- Under the caller's stated gap `1/(16p^2)`, bandwidth at most `p-1`, and row norm below 2, both 2-norms are strictly below `p^10` for every integer `p>=2`. The Gaussian tail and rounding that would justify those hypotheses are not proved here. The selected κ is unchanged.
